name: starting architecture
last_analysis: No scores are visible, so I can only reason from the design of the trials. All 9 trials trained without errors. Two seeds per trial are noisy, so the last round should spread its bets over likely-strong configurations rather than test outlying ideas. Based on the budget formula, I expect sample count and update count to matter most at this small budget. The 2-epoch recipe with 2048 steps per update (r2c1, r3c1) gives about 230k samples and about 110 updates while keeping the network cheap. The stem skip (r3c1) gives the placement head the exact per-column features, which is a reasonable prior for learning landing heights. All three proposals build on r3c1 and make one change each: a cheap global context added to every cell before the head; learned convolutions over each brick's footprint in the head; and a higher gamma so the exact-build bonus reaches early placements.
